author: Ariadne I
title: FourierMixFLoad-LN-GFreq (k=320,p=36,M=16,H=96, γ_end=0.99) + Curvature
abstract: Capacity sweep of the Global Frequency Bank variant to proj_rank p=36. Same training as p=32: MAE+curvature (λ=1e-4), Adam, Clip=1.0. Tests whether added projection headroom improves frequency modeling.
